description: Statically analyze a specific Liquid file for performance anti-patterns. Requires legacy cookie authentication (use 'login_legacy' tool).

fileName.description: Specific file to analyze (e.g., 'layout/theme.liquid'). If omitted, analyzes layout/theme.liquid.

themeId.description: Theme ID to analyze. Defaults to the live (main) theme.

name: analyze_liquid_file
